cases.sentence: В сентябре Левин переехал в ___ для родов Китти.
cases.translation: In September Levin moved to Moscow for Kitty's confinement.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion toward a destination governs the accusative case, giving Москву.

cases.sentence: Он уже жил без дела целый месяц в ___.
cases.translation: He had already been living idle for a whole month in Moscow.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case, giving Москве.

cases.sentence: Сергей Иванович, имевший ___ в Кашинской губернии, собрался ехать на выборы.
cases.translation: Sergei Ivanovich, who had an estate in Kashin province, prepared to go to the elections.
cases.explain: Имение is the direct object of the transitive participle имевший (having), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: У Левина было в Кашине крайне нужное для ___ его дело по опеке.
cases.translation: Levin had in Kashin a matter regarding guardianship that was extremely necessary for his sister.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) governs the genitive case, giving сестры.

cases.sentence: Китти заказала ему дворянский ___, стоивший 80 рублей.
cases.translation: Kitty ordered for him a gentry uniform costing 80 roubles.
cases.explain: Мундир is the direct object of the transitive verb заказала (ordered), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Левин был в ___ уже шестой день.
cases.translation: Levin had already been in Kashin for six days.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case, giving Кашине.

cases.sentence: Нужна была подпись ___, а председатель был на сессии.
cases.translation: The chairman's signature was needed, but the chairman was in session.
cases.explain: Подпись председателя (the chairman's signature) requires the genitive case of the possessor noun, giving председателя.

cases.sentence: Левин испытывал это часто, разговаривая со своим добродушнейшим ___.
cases.translation: Levin often felt this while talking with his good-natured attorney.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case, giving поверенным.

cases.sentence: Сергей Иванович объяснил ему смысл и значение предполагавшегося на ___ переворота.
cases.translation: Sergei Ivanovich explained to him the meaning and significance of the upheaval anticipated at the elections.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location at an event governs the prepositional case, giving выборах.

cases.translation: The governor gave a speech to the noblemen.
cases.explain: The indirect object of сказать (to say/address to someone) takes the dative case, giving дворянам.

reading.ru: В сентябре Левин переехал в Москву для родов Китти.
reading.question: Why did Levin move to Moscow in September?
options: To take up a government post
reading.explain: The text opens by saying Levin moved to Moscow in September for Kitty's confinement.

reading.ru: Он звал с собою и брата, у которого был шар по Селезневскому уезду.
reading.question: Why did Sergei Ivanovich invite Levin to come to the elections?
options: Because Levin had a voting ball (vote) in Seleznevsky district
Because Levin was running for office
Because Levin wanted to meet Vronsky
reading.correct: Because Levin had a voting ball (vote) in Seleznevsky district
reading.explain: The text says Sergei Ivanovich called his brother along because he had a vote (шар) in the Seleznevsky district.

reading.ru: И эти 80 рублей, заплаченные за мундир, были главной причиной, побудившей Левина ехать.
reading.question: What ultimately motivated Levin to go to the elections?
options: The 80 roubles already spent on the uniform Kitty ordered
A direct order from his brother
reading.correct: The 80 roubles already spent on the uniform Kitty ordered
reading.explain: The text says the 80 roubles paid for the uniform were the main reason that prompted Levin to go.

reading.ru: Левин был в Кашине уже шестой день, посещая каждый день собрания и хлопоча по делу сестры, которая все не ладилась.
reading.question: What was Levin doing during his days in Kashin?
options: Attending meetings daily and struggling with his sister's unresolved legal matter
Studying agriculture at the local college
reading.correct: Attending meetings daily and struggling with his sister's unresolved legal matter
reading.explain: The text says he had been in Kashin six days, attending meetings daily and struggling with his sister's affair, which was not going well.

reading.ru: Все эти хлопоты, хождение из места в место, разговоры с очень добрыми, хорошими людьми, понимающими вполне неприятность положения просителя, но не могущими пособить ему, все это напряжение, не дающее никаких результатов, произвело в Левине чувство мучительное, подобное тому досадному бессилию, которое испытываешь во сне
reading.question: What feeling did all this fruitless bureaucratic effort produce in Levin?
options: A painful feeling like the helplessness one feels in a dream
A sense of triumph and accomplishment
reading.correct: A painful feeling like the helplessness one feels in a dream
reading.explain: The text compares the tension and lack of results to the tormenting helplessness one experiences in a dream.

reading.ru: «Вот что попробуйте», — не раз говорил он. «Съездите туда-то и туда-то».
reading.question: What kind of advice did the attorney repeatedly give Levin?
options: To try going here and there to various offices
To give up on the matter entirely
To appeal directly to the governor
reading.correct: To try going here and there to various offices
reading.explain: The attorney kept telling Levin to try this or that, suggesting he go to various places.

reading.ru: В особенности было обидно то, что Левин не мог никак понять, с кем он борется, кому выгода от того, что его дело не кончается.
reading.question: What was especially frustrating for Levin about the bureaucratic obstruction?
options: He could not understand whom he was fighting or who benefited from the delay
He could not afford the legal fees
He was being openly insulted by officials
He had lost the relevant documents
reading.correct: He could not understand whom he was fighting or who benefited from the delay
reading.explain: The text says it was especially galling that Levin could not understand with whom he was struggling or who profited from his case dragging on.

reading.ru: Но Левин много изменился со времени своей женитьбы.
reading.question: How had Levin changed since the text describes his current attitude?
options: He had changed a great deal since his marriage, becoming more patient
He had lost interest in his estate
reading.correct: He had changed a great deal since his marriage, becoming more patient
reading.explain: The text states Levin had changed much since his marriage and had become patient, trying not to be indignant.

reading.ru: Сергей Иванович объяснил ему смысл и значение предполагавшегося на выборах переворота.
reading.question: What did Sergei Ivanovich explain to Levin?
options: The meaning and significance of the political upheaval expected at the elections
The history of the Kashin nobility
reading.correct: The meaning and significance of the political upheaval expected at the elections
reading.explain: The text says Sergei Ivanovich explained to him the meaning and significance of the anticipated upheaval at the elections.

reading.ru: Губернский предводитель Снетков был человек старого дворянского склада, проживший огромное состояние, добрый человек, честный в своем роде, но совершенно не понимавший потребностей нового времени.
reading.question: How is the provincial marshal Snetkov described?
options: A good, honest man of the old gentry mold who did not understand modern needs
A young reformer eager for change
A wealthy merchant with no title
reading.correct: A good, honest man of the old gentry mold who did not understand modern needs
reading.explain: The text describes Snetkov as a kind, honest man of the old noble type who had squandered a huge fortune and completely failed to understand the needs of the new era.

reading.ru: Предводителям на место Снедкова предполагалось поставить или Свиярского, или еще лучше Неведовского, бывшего профессора, замечательно умного человека и большого приятеля Сергея Ивановича.
reading.question: Who were the proposed candidates to replace Snetkov as marshal?
options: Svyazhsky, or better yet Nevedovsky, a former professor
reading.correct: Svyazhsky, or better yet Nevedovsky, a former professor
reading.explain: The text states it was proposed to put Svyazhsky, or better still Nevedovsky, a former professor, in Snetkov's place.

reading.ru: Собрание открыл губернатор, который сказал речь дворянам, чтобы они выбирали должностных лиц не по лицеприятию, а по заслугам и для благо Отечества
reading.question: What did the governor urge the nobles to do in his opening speech?
options: To elect officials based on merit, not favoritism, for the good of the fatherland
reading.correct: To elect officials based on merit, not favoritism, for the good of the fatherland
reading.explain: The governor's speech urged the nobles to choose officials not by favoritism but by merit, for the good of the fatherland.

reading.ru: В соборе Левин, вместе с другими поднимая руку и повторяя слова протопопа, клялся самыми страшными клятвами исполнять все то, на что надеялся губернатор.
reading.question: What did Levin do in the cathedral?
options: Swore terrible oaths along with the others, repeating the archpriest's words
Gave a speech of his own
reading.correct: Swore terrible oaths along with the others, repeating the archpriest's words
reading.explain: The text describes Levin raising his hand with the others and repeating the archpriest's words, swearing the most terrible oaths.

reading.ru: На четвертый день за губернским столом шла поверка губернских сумм.
reading.question: What was being verified on the fourth day at the provincial table?
options: The results of the previous election
reading.explain: The text says that on the fourth day there was a verification of the provincial funds at the provincial table.

reading.ru: На пятый день были выборы уездных предводителей.
reading.question: What took place on the fifth day?
options: The elections of the district marshals
The final vote for the provincial marshal
A ball hosted by the governor
The reading of the guardianship report
reading.correct: The elections of the district marshals
reading.explain: The text states that on the fifth day the elections of the district marshals took place.
